data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Hausman, Levine, Finn, and Ichter, is currently valued at $5.6B post-money following $600M+ in total raises. The valuation is assessed against a peer universe of 9 comparable companies spanning early-stage to late-stage AI ventures, including public reference (Palantir/PLTR) and private comparables such as Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Together AI ($8.3B, Series A), and Black Forest Labs ($3.2B, Series B).

Two primary valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation, implying $10.6B. Peer-median valuation across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $14.0B, with a range spanning $3.2B to $39.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous market assessments of frontier AI companies at varying stages.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $9.0B (low) to $16.1B (high), with a median of $12.3B. This implies 54–188% upside from the current $5.6B valuation. Key uncertainties include the appropriate peer set weighting given wide valuation spread among comparables, and whether stage-progression multipliers calibrated on earlier-stage software hold for frontier AI. The current valuation sits at the lower quartile of the derived range.
